name: Bean Burrito Bowl with Rice, Cheese, Yogurt, Guacamole, Salsa & Chips
instructions: Drain and rinse beans; transfer to a medium saucepan.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and add to the pan with the beans. Add water and taco seasoning; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook until liquid is fully absorbed, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips; place in a medium bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the lettuce.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide rice and beans, salad, chips, cheese, yogurt, and lime wedges between bowls; serve with guacamole and salsa on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
